prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: Costa Rica here we come!!  https://t.co/F99YNDe1kP
Delta: Good day Tampa Bay! Awesome picture. Thank you for sharing and enjoy your flight.  *TDH

Customer: S/O to  crew out of GEG #DL5706 2day for going above and beyond in helping us with TONS of baggage as we move to Costa Rica. #puravida https://t.co/xhpLArsqhX
Delta: Hi. Thx for publicly complimenting our flt crew on DL5706 GEG/SEA. It's comforting to hear how they went above and beyond to help you. *HJH

Customer: worst first class ever!!!!!!
Coach would have been just as comfortable. Joke!!!
Delta: I apologize that your experience with us was not as enjoyable as anticipated. May i have you to DM your confirmation to me?  *TAS https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: Flying that first class  👌🏻
Delta: What a wonderful way to travel! Enjoy that spacious seat! *TBW

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: inflight_experience):
"""flight 356 from Costa Rica cold raw dinner in first class. Ran out of Chardonnay half way through the flight which has never happened because they usually go to coach an get some. Absolutely the worst first class service ever for me in 19 years of Delta as plat or diam"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: We’re sorry your First Class experience on flight 356 didn’t meet expectations. Please DM us your confirmation number so we can look into this further.
